videos.title: Train Guard Ka Khofnak Safar | Raat Ki Kahaniyan #shorts
videos.topic: An overnight train guard checks a completely empty sleeper bogie, only to find his own dead grandfather sitting on the top berth meticulously packing a suitcase.
videos.style: Pehla shakhs (main) apni aap beeti sunata hai, dheemi aur sargoshi wali awaaz mein
